parts.text: In this experiment, you will investigate the principle of moments. Carry out the following instructions referring to Fig. 1.1. Fig. 1.1 You are provided with a piece of modelling clay.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Mould the piece of modelling clay into a cube shape. Place the modelling clay on the rule so that its centre is at a distance d = 10.0 cm from the zero end of the rule as shown in Fig. 1.1. Adjust the position of the rule so that it is as near as possible to being balanced, with the 50.0 cm mark to the right of the pivot.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Measure the distance x from the centre of the modelling clay to the pivot. x = ......................................................

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Measure the distance y from the pivot to the 50.0 cm mark on the rule. y = ......................................................

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) The mass M of the metre rule is provided for you on a card. Record this value. M = ......................................................

parts.label: iv
parts.text: (iv) Calculate the mass m 1 of the piece of modelling clay using the equation m 1 = My x . m 1 = ...................................................... [3]

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Divide the modelling clay into two pieces, with one piece approximately twice the size of the other piece.
